schema.title: Response Export Memory Api Memory Export Get

200.description: SSE: run_event JSON has id (decimal string), run_id, kind, payload, created_at. status has run_id/status. end has reason terminal or reconnect. session_expired and access_lost have code. Only run_event advances the cursor. Comments are heartbeats. Streams close after 25 seconds; resume with Last-Event-ID (takes precedence over after). Refresh run detail for results/actions; events are progress notifications, not token streaming.
